preconditions.description: The number of positions n must be between 1 and 60000.
The number of die faces m must be between 4 and 100000.
The number of turns k must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= n for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: Each field value f_i must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_j < M for p_j in p)
preconditions.description: Each die face probability p_j must be between 0 and M-1.
The sum of all die face probabilities must be 1 modulo M.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i < M for x_i in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output value x_i must be between 0 and M-1.

postconditions.expression: sum(x_i for x_i in stdout) % M == 1
postconditions.description: The sum of all output probabilities must be 1 modulo M.
